responsibility: Implements the runtime exception-handling engine for GNU Modula-2, including exception blocks with text buffers, per-exception handler stacks, raising and dispatching exceptions, tracking whether execution is in an exception state, and maintaining the current exception block and source. It also provides the default error catch path and configuration that maps base language exceptions to THROW-style handlers, making it the core exception infrastructure beneath M2EXCEPTION and M2RTS.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the concrete runtime implementation behind GRTExceptions.h: it defines the exception-block and handler data structures, manages handler/free lists and current exception state/source, and provides the executable raise/dispatch and default-catch behavior that the header only declares through an opaque EHBlock API.
